dedupe_keys.name: du philippine repeaters directory of amateur radio repeaters in the philippines para

description: The Philippine Amateur Radio Association keeps a directory of the amateur radio repeaters run by clubs across the Philippines. The page read on 2026-09-28 gives a table with each club's name, call district, club callsign, repeater frequency in MHz, offset, access tone, location (in some cases with latitude and longitude), Maidenhead grid locator and the schedule of its regular net, for example DX1L of the Philippine Amateur Radio League on 144.600 MHz in Antipolo City and PARA's own DX1PAR on 144.740 MHz on Mt. Mataba, San Mateo, Rizal; clubs add or update entries through an online form or by e-mail to the secretariat. Coverage is national, by amateur radio district. Access is free as a web table; no licence is stated. Caveats: entries are self-reported by clubs, some lack coordinates, and operating status is not verified. It supports planning of backup emergency communications during typhoons and earthquakes, when amateur repeater networks carry traffic for disaster response. Related records: data-sral-finland-automatic-amateur-radio-stations is a comparable national register.
